lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Later, Ahab wanted Naboth's vineyard because it was beside the king's palace. Naboth refused to sell the inheritance that belonged to his family.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jezebel arranged false accusations against Naboth. He was condemned and killed, and Ahab took possession of the vineyard.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Go down to meet Ahab in Naboth's vineyard. He has gone there to take possession of it.

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: This is what the LORD says: You have murdered Naboth and taken his land. Because you have given yourself to evil, judgment is coming upon your house.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Elijah's ministry was not only about miracles. He also confronted kings when power was used to crush the innocent.
